name: Satisfactory
description: First-person open-world factory building. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Server port
variables.description: Since 1.0 a single port carries game traffic (UDP) and the HTTPS API (TCP).

variables.label: Beta branch
variables.description: e.g. 'experimental' — leave empty for the stable branch.

notes: After first start, claim the server (set admin password and create the game) from the in-game Server Manager or via the HTTPS API on the same port. On Linux, saves live in ~/.config/Epic/FactoryGame/Saved/SaveGames/server — outside the server directory, so panel backups do not include them by default. Windows hosts: set the start command override to FactoryServer.exe -Port={{SERVER_PORT}}.
